items.headline: Apple implements price hikes for its TV streaming service and 'One' subscription bundle
items.summary: Apple TV's streaming price increased from $12.99 to $14.99 per month. The Apple One subscription also went up as part of the latest hike.

items.headline: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
items.summary: The U.S. struck a deal with Venezuela to get majority control of more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves, Trump said in a social media post.

items.headline: U.S. appeals court rules against prediction markets, sets up likely fight at Supreme Court
items.summary: The 9th U.S. Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that sports-related event contracts are not swaps, contradicting a 3rd Circuit ruling from April.

items.summary: War weighs on Iran's economy as US intensifies sanctions  Reuters

Mark Walter's insurer Delaware Life sees two banks pause sale of its products amid probes
items.summary: Walter's holding company earlier in the week said "there has been no fraud" at Delaware Life and its affiliated company, Clear Spring Life and Annuity.

items.headline: Indian bank stocks see sharp NSE-BSE price gaps under new auction system
items.summary: Indian bank stocks saw sharp NSE-BSE closing price gaps, with IndusInd Bank recording a nearly ₹33 difference amid scrutiny of the new auction system.

items.headline: Trump loses bid to transfer New York hush money case to federal court
items.summary: Trump's conviction in the hush money case relates to conduct that preceded the 2016 presidential election, which led to his first term in the White House.

items.headline: Bessent attacks Warren over yen intervention query, offers ‘Foreign Exchange for Dummies’ lesson
items.summary: Treasury has not disclosed how much yen it bought, the execution rate or the current value of the position, despite Warren’s requests for details.

items.headline: CEO of buy now, pay later giant Affirm says high gas prices are hitting U.S. shoppers
items.summary: The national average price for gas is at $4.09 per gallon and was last below $3 on March 2.

items.headline: 2-year Treasury yield jumps as Warsh says Fed may 'have work to do'
items.summary: Investors assessed Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish message in his keynote address at Jackson Hole.

items.headline: Corn and wheat prices jump to highest prices in more than three years
items.summary: Corn and wheat futures have surged to their highest levels in more than three years. But the reasons for these recent rallies are notably different.

items.headline: Stock traders warm up to Warsh as volatility index touches year-to-date low
items.summary: The Cboe Volatility Index (VIX), which measures the price of 30-day options on the S&P 500 Index, fell to as low as 14.1.
